structure IBMBackendCalibrationData where
  t1_times_ns : List Float
  t2_times_ns : List Float
  readout_errors : List Float
  gate_errors : List Float
  coupling_map : List (Nat × Nat)
  num_qubits : Nat

def IBMBackendCalibrationData.invariant (data : IBMBackendCalibrationData) : Prop :=
  data.t1_times_ns.length = data.num_qubits ∧
  data.t2_times_ns.length = data.num_qubits ∧
  data.readout_errors.length = data.num_qubits ∧
  (∀ t ∈ data.t1_times_ns, t > 0) ∧
  (∀ t ∈ data.t2_times_ns, t > 0) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ data.readout_errors, 0 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ data.gate_errors, 0 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ (q1, q2) ∈ data.coupling_map, q1 < data.num_qubits ∧ q2 < data.num_qubits)

structure IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs where
  t1_mean_ns : Float
  t1_stddev_ns : Float
  t2_mean_ns : Float
  t2_stddev_ns : Float
  readout_error_mean : Float
  readout_error_stddev : Float
  ecr_gate_error_mean : Float
  ecr_gate_error_stddev : Float

def IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs.invariant (specs : IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs) : Prop :=
  specs.t1_mean_ns > 0 ∧
  specs.t1_stddev_ns ≥ 0 ∧
  specs.t2_mean_ns > 0 ∧
  specs.t2_stddev_ns ≥ 0 ∧
  0 ≤ specs.readout_error_mean ∧ specs.readout_error_mean ≤ 1 ∧
  0 ≤ specs.readout_error_stddev ∧
  0 ≤ specs.ecr_gate_error_mean ∧ specs.ecr_gate_error_mean ≤ 1 ∧
  0 ≤ specs.ecr_gate_error_stddev

inductive QuantumBackendType where
  | SIMULATOR_STATEVECTOR
  | SIMULATOR_MPS
  | SIMULATOR_STABILIZER
  | HARDWARE_FALCON
  | HARDWARE_HERON
  | HARDWARE_EAGLE
  | HARDWARE_OSPREY
  | HARDWARE_CONDOR
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def getForBackendType (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) : IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs :=
  match backend_type with
  | QuantumBackendType.HARDWARE_HERON =>
    { t1_mean_ns := 350000.0,
      t1_stddev_ns := 75000.0,
      t2_mean_ns := 200000.0,
      t2_stddev_ns := 50000.0,
      readout_error_mean := 0.008,
      readout_error_stddev := 0.003,
      ecr_gate_error_mean := 0.003,
      ecr_gate_error_stddev := 0.001 }
  | QuantumBackendType.HARDWARE_EAGLE =>
    { t1_mean_ns := 200000.0,
      t1_stddev_ns := 60000.0,
      t2_mean_ns := 120000.0,
      t2_stddev_ns := 40000.0,
      readout_error_mean := 0.015,
      readout_error_stddev := 0.005,
      ecr_gate_error_mean := 0.005,
      ecr_gate_error_stddev := 0.002 }
  | QuantumBackendType.HARDWARE_FALCON =>
    { t1_mean_ns := 100000.0,
      t1_stddev_ns := 30000.0,
      t2_mean_ns := 80000.0,
      t2_stddev_ns := 25000.0,
      readout_error_mean := 0.020,
      readout_error_stddev := 0.008,
      ecr_gate_error_mean := 0.007,
      ecr_gate_error_stddev := 0.003 }
  | QuantumBackendType.HARDWARE_OSPREY =>
    { t1_mean_ns := 250000.0,
      t1_stddev_ns := 70000.0,
      t2_mean_ns := 150000.0,
      t2_stddev_ns := 45000.0,
      readout_error_mean := 0.012,
      readout_error_stddev := 0.004,
      ecr_gate_error_mean := 0.004,
      ecr_gate_error_stddev := 0.0015 }
  | QuantumBackendType.HARDWARE_CONDOR =>
    { t1_mean_ns := 400000.0,
      t1_stddev_ns := 100000.0,
      t2_mean_ns := 250000.0,
      t2_stddev_ns := 60000.0,
      readout_error_mean := 0.006,
      readout_error_stddev := 0.002,
      ecr_gate_error_mean := 0.002,
      ecr_gate_error_stddev := 0.0008 }
  | _ =>
    { t1_mean_ns := 150000.0,
      t1_stddev_ns := 50000.0,
      t2_mean_ns := 100000.0,
      t2_stddev_ns := 35000.0,
      readout_error_mean := 0.018,
      readout_error_stddev := 0.006,
      ecr_gate_error_mean := 0.006,
      ecr_gate_error_stddev := 0.002 }

theorem getForBackendType_invariant (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) :
  IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs.invariant (getForBackendType backend_type) := by
  cases backend_type <;> simp [getForBackendType, IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs.invariant] <;> norm_num

def generateLinearCoupling (num_qubits : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  let forward := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i => (i, i + 1))
  let backward := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i => (i + 1, i))
  forward ++ backward

theorem generateLinearCoupling_valid (num_qubits : Nat) (h : num_qubits > 0) :
  ∀ (q1, q2) ∈ generateLinearCoupling num_qubits, q1 < num_qubits ∧ q2 < num_qubits := by
  intro pair h_pair
  simp [generateLinearCoupling] at h_pair
  cases h_pair with
  | inl h_fwd =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h_fwd
    simp [List.mem_range] at hi
    constructor
    · omega
    · omega
  | inr h_bwd =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h_bwd
    simp [List.mem_range] at hi
    constructor
    · omega
    · omega

def generateDocumentedCalibration (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) : IBMBackendCalibrationData :=
  let specs := getForBackendType backend_type
  let config := defaultQuantumConfig
  let t1 := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    let qubit_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    specs.t1_mean_ns + qubit_variation * specs.t1_stddev_ns)
  let t2 := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    let qubit_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    specs.t2_mean_ns + qubit_variation * specs.t2_stddev_ns)
  let readout_err := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    let qubit_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    max config.min_readout_error (specs.readout_error_mean + qubit_variation * specs.readout_error_stddev))
  let coupling := if num_qubits > 0 then generateLinearCoupling num_qubits else []
  let edge_count := coupling.length
  let gate_err := List.range edge_count |>.map (fun i =>
    let edge_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    max config.min_gate_error (specs.ecr_gate_error_mean + edge_variation * specs.ecr_gate_error_stddev))
  { t1_times_ns := t1,
    t2_times_ns := t2,
    readout_errors := readout_err,
    gate_errors := gate_err,
    coupling_map := coupling,
    num_qubits := num_qubits }

theorem generateDocumentedCalibration_length (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) :
  let data := generateDocumentedCalibration backend_type num_qubits
  data.t1_times_ns.length = num_qubits ∧
  data.t2_times_ns.length = num_qubits ∧
  data.readout_errors.length = num_qubits := by
  simp [generateDocumentedCalibration]
  constructor
  · simp [List.length_map, List.length_range]
  · constructor
    · simp [List.length_map, List.length_range]
    · simp [List.length_map, List.length_range]

theorem generateDocumentedCalibration_positive_times (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) (h : num_qubits > 0) :
  let data := generateDocumentedCalibration backend_type num_qubits
  (∀ t ∈ data.t1_times_ns, t > 0) ∧ (∀ t ∈ data.t2_times_ns, t > 0) := by
  sorry

structure IBMQuantumCredentials where
  crn : String
  api_key : String
  instance : String
  region : String
  account_id : String
  resource_id : String

def IBMQuantumCredentials.invariant (creds : IBMQuantumCredentials) : Prop :=
  creds.crn.length > 0 ∧
  creds.api_key.length > 0 ∧
  creds.instance.length > 0 ∧
  creds.region.length > 0

def parseCRN (crn_string : String) (api_key : String) : IBMQuantumCredentials :=
  let config := defaultQuantumConfig
  let parts := crn_string.splitOn ":"
  let region := if h : config.crn_region_index < parts.length then parts[config.crn_region_index] else config.default_region
  let account_part := if h : config.crn_account_index < parts.length then parts[config.crn_account_index] else ""
  let account_id := if account_part.startsWith config.account_prefix then account_part.drop 2 else ""
  let resource_id := if h : config.crn_resource_index < parts.length then parts[config.crn_resource_index] else ""
  { crn := crn_string,
    api_key := api_key,
    instance := config.default_instance,
    region := if region.length > 0 then region else config.default_region,
    account_id := account_id,
    resource_id := resource_id }

theorem parseCRN_preserves_crn (crn_string api_key : String) :
  (parseCRN crn_string api_key).crn = crn_string := by
  simp [parseCRN]

theorem parseCRN_preserves_api_key (crn_string api_key : String) :
  (parseCRN crn_string api_key).api_key = api_key := by
  simp [parseCRN]

def getServiceURL (creds : IBMQuantumCredentials) : String :=
  ""

def getRuntimeURL (creds : IBMQuantumCredentials) : String :=
  ""

inductive BackendStatus where
  | ONLINE
  | OFFLINE
  | MAINTENANCE
  | CALIBRATING
  | RESERVED
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure QuantumBackend where
  name : String
  backend_type : QuantumBackendType
  num_qubits : Nat
  basis_gates : List String
  coupling_map : List (Nat × Nat)
  t1_times_ns : List Float
  t2_times_ns : List Float
  readout_errors : List Float
  gate_errors : List Float
  is_simulator : Bool
  max_shots : Nat
  max_circuits : Nat
  status : BackendStatus
  pending_jobs : Nat
  queue_position : Nat

def QuantumBackend.invariant (backend : QuantumBackend) : Prop :=
  backend.name.length > 0 ∧
  backend.num_qubits > 0 ∧
  backend.basis_gates.length > 0 ∧
  backend.t1_times_ns.length ≤ backend.num_qubits ∧
  backend.t2_times_ns.length ≤ backend.num_qubits ∧
  backend.readout_errors.length ≤ backend.num_qubits ∧
  (∀ (q1, q2) ∈ backend.coupling_map, q1 < backend.num_qubits ∧ q2 < backend.num_qubits) ∧
  backend.max_shots > 0 ∧
  backend.max_circuits > 0

def initSimulator (name : String) (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumBackend :=
  let config := defaultQuantumConfig
  let basis := ["id", "rz", "sx", "x", "cx", "reset"]
  { name := name,
    backend_type := QuantumBackendType.SIMULATOR_STATEVECTOR,
    num_qubits := num_qubits,
    basis_gates := basis,
    coupling_map := [],
    t1_times_ns := [],
    t2_times_ns := [],
    readout_errors := [],
    gate_errors := [],
    is_simulator := true,
    max_shots := config.simulator_max_shots,
    max_circuits := config.simulator_max_circuits,
    status := BackendStatus.ONLINE,
    pending_jobs := 0,
    queue_position := 0 }

theorem initSimulator_is_simulator (name : String) (num_qubits : Nat) (h : num_qubits > 0) :
  (initSimulator name num_qubits).is_simulator = true := by
  simp [initSimulator]

theorem initSimulator_invariant (name : String) (num_qubits : Nat) (h1 : num_qubits > 0) (h2 : name.length > 0) :
  QuantumBackend.invariant (initSimulator name num_qubits) := by
  simp [QuantumBackend.invariant, initSimulator, defaultQuantumConfig]
  constructor
  · exact h2
  · constructor
    · exact h1
    · constructor
      · simp [List.length_cons]
        omega
      · constructor
        · simp [List.length_nil]
          omega
        · constructor
          · simp [List.length_nil]
            omega
          · constructor
            · simp [List.length_nil]
              omega
            · constructor
              · intro q1 q2 h
                simp at h
              · constructor
                · norm_num
                · norm_num

def initHardware (name : String) (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumBackend :=
  let config := defaultQuantumConfig
  let basis := ["id", "rz", "sx", "x", "ecr", "reset", "measure"]
  let calibration := generateDocumentedCalibration backend_type num_qubits
  { name := name,
    backend_type := backend_type,
    num_qubits := num_qubits,
    basis_gates := basis,
    coupling_map := calibration.coupling_map,
    t1_times_ns := calibration.t1_times_ns,
    t2_times_ns := calibration.t2_times_ns,
    readout_errors := calibration.readout_errors,
    gate_errors := calibration.gate_errors,
    is_simulator := false,
    max_shots := config.hardware_max_shots,
    max_circuits := config.hardware_max_circuits,
    status := BackendStatus.ONLINE,
    pending_jobs := 0,
    queue_position := 0 }

theorem initHardware_not_simulator (name : String) (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) :
  (initHardware name backend_type num_qubits).is_simulator = false := by
  simp [initHardware]

def getAverageT1 (backend : QuantumBackend) : Float :=
  if backend.t1_times_ns.length = 0 then
    0.0
  else
    backend.t1_times_ns.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.t1_times_ns.length.toFloat

def getAverageT2 (backend : QuantumBackend) : Float :=
  if backend.t2_times_ns.length = 0 then
    0.0
  else
    backend.t2_times_ns.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.t2_times_ns.length.toFloat

def getAverageReadoutError (backend : QuantumBackend) : Float :=
  if backend.readout_errors.length = 0 then
    0.0
  else
    backend.readout_errors.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.readout_errors.length.toFloat

def getAverageGateError (backend : QuantumBackend) : Float :=
  if backend.gate_errors.length = 0 then
    0.0
  else
    backend.gate_errors.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.gate_errors.length.toFloat

theorem getAverageT1_nonnegative (backend : QuantumBackend) :
  getAverageT1 backend ≥ 0 := by
  simp [getAverageT1]
  split
  · norm_num
  · sorry

def floatPow (base : Float) (exp : Float) : Float := sorry

def floatExp (x : Float) : Float := sorry

def estimateFidelity (backend : QuantumBackend) (circuit_depth : Nat) (num_two_qubit_gates : Nat) : Float :=
  if backend.is_simulator then
    1.0
  else
    let config := defaultQuantumConfig
    let avg_gate_error := getAverageGateError backend
    let avg_readout_error := getAverageReadoutError backend
    let gate_fidelity := floatPow (1.0 - avg_gate_error) num_two_qubit_gates.toFloat
    let readout_fidelity := 1.0 - avg_readout_error
    let depth_factor := floatExp (-(circuit_depth.toFloat / config.depth_decay_factor))
    gate_fidelity * readout_fidelity * depth_factor

theorem estimateFidelity_simulator_perfect (backend : QuantumBackend) (circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates : Nat) (h : backend.is_simulator = true) :
  estimateFidelity backend circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates = 1.0 := by
  simp [estimateFidelity, h]

theorem estimateFidelity_bounded (backend : QuantumBackend) (circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates : Nat) :
  0 ≤ estimateFidelity backend circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates ∧
  estimateFidelity backend circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates ≤ 1.0 := by

def computeQubitDepths (instructions : List QuantumInstruction) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  instructions.foldl (fun depths inst =>
    let current_max := inst.qubits.foldl (fun m q =>
      max m (depths.lookup q |>.getD 0)) 0
    let new_depth := current_max + 1
    inst.qubits.foldl (fun ds q =>
      (q, new_depth) :: (ds.filter (fun (k, _) => k ≠ q))) depths
  ) []

def getDepth (circuit : QuantumCircuit) : Nat :=
  let depths := computeQubitDepths circuit.instructions
  depths.foldl (fun m (_, d) => max m d) 0

def toOpenQASM3 (circuit : QuantumCircuit) : String :=
  let header := "OPENQASM 3.0;\ninclude \"stdgates.inc\";\n\n"
  let qubit_decl := s!"qubit[{circuit.num_qubits}] q;\n"
  let bit_decl := s!"bit[{circuit.num_classical_bits}] c;\n\n"
  let body := circuit.instructions.foldl (fun acc inst =>
    let gate_str := match inst.gate with
      | QuantumGateOp.MEASURE =>
        if inst.classical_bits.length > 0 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"c[{inst.classical_bits.head!}] = measure q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.BARRIER =>
        let qubit_strs := inst.qubits.map (fun q => s!"q[{q}]")
        "barrier " ++ String.intercalate ", " qubit_strs ++ ";\n"
      | QuantumGateOp.RX | QuantumGateOp.RY | QuantumGateOp.RZ | QuantumGateOp.U1 =>
        if inst.parameters.length > 0 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters.head!}) q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.U2 =>
        if inst.parameters.length >= 2 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters[0]!}, {floatToString inst.parameters[1]!}) q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.U3 =>
        if inst.parameters.length >= 3 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters[0]!}, {floatToString inst.parameters[1]!}, {floatToString inst.parameters[2]!}) q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.CX | QuantumGateOp.CY | QuantumGateOp.CZ | QuantumGateOp.CH
      | QuantumGateOp.ECR | QuantumGateOp.SWAP | QuantumGateOp.ISWAP =>
        if inst.qubits.length >= 2 then
          s!"{getGateName inst} q[{inst.qubits[0]!}], q[{inst.qubits[1]!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.CRX | QuantumGateOp.CRY | QuantumGateOp.CRZ =>
        if inst.parameters.length > 0 && inst.qubits.length >= 2 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters.head!}) q[{inst.qubits[0]!}], q[{inst.qubits[1]!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.CCX | QuantumGateOp.CSWAP =>
        if inst.qubits.length >= 3 then
          s!"{getGateName inst} q[{inst.qubits[0]!}], q[{inst.qubits[1]!}], q[{inst.qubits[2]!}];\n"
        else ""
      | _ =>
        if inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst} q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
    acc ++ gate_str
  ) ""
  header ++ qubit_decl ++ bit_decl ++ body

theorem toOpenQASM3_nonempty (circuit : QuantumCircuit) (h : circuit.num_qubits > 0) :
  (toOpenQASM3 circuit).length > 0 := by
  sorry

def QuantumResult.invariant (result : QuantumResult) : Prop :=
  result.job_id.length > 0 ∧
  result.backend_name.length > 0 ∧
  result.shots > 0 ∧
  (result.counts.foldl (fun sum (_, count) => sum + count) 0 ≤ result.shots)

  QuantumResult.invariant (initResult job_id backend_name shots) := by
  simp [QuantumResult.invariant, initResult]
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, by simp⟩

  { result with counts := (bitstring, count) :: result.counts.filter (fun (bs, _) => bs ≠ bitstring) }

  result.counts.lookup bitstring |>.getD 0

def getProbability (result : QuantumResult) (bitstring : String) : Float :=
  if result.shots = 0 then 0.0
  else (getCount result bitstring).toFloat / result.shots.toFloat

  0 ≤ getProbability result bitstring ∧ getProbability result bitstring ≤ 1.0 := by
  sorry

def getEntropy (result : QuantumResult) : Float :=
  result.counts.foldl (fun entropy (_, count) =>
    let p := count.toFloat / result.shots.toFloat
    if p > 0.0 then
      entropy - p * floatLog p / floatLog 2.0
    else
      entropy
  ) 0.0

theorem getEntropy_nonnegative (result : QuantumResult) (h : result.shots > 0) :
  getEntropy result ≥ 0 := by
  sorry

  let name := s!"ghz_{num_qubits}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let with_h := applyH circuit 0
  let with_cnots := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.foldl
    (fun c i => applyCX c 0 (i + 1)) with_h
  measureAll with_cnots

  let circuit := createGHZState client num_qubits

def createQFT (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"qft_{num_qubits}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let pi := 3.14159265359
  let with_gates := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c i =>
    let with_h := applyH c i
    List.range (num_qubits - i - 1) |>.foldl (fun c2 j =>
      let k := j - i + 1
      let angle := pi / floatPow 2.0 k.toFloat
      c2 |> applyRZ (i + j + 1) angle
         |> applyCX i (i + j + 1)
         |> applyRZ (i + j + 1) (-angle)
         |> applyCX i (i + j + 1)
    ) with_h
  ) circuit
  let with_swaps := List.range (num_qubits / 2) |>.foldl (fun c i =>
    applySWAP c i (num_qubits - 1 - i)
  ) with_gates
  measureAll with_swaps

def createGrover (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) (marked_state : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"grover_{num_qubits}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let pi := 3.14159265359
  let init_circuit := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c i => applyH c i) circuit
  let state_space_size := floatPow 2.0 num_qubits.toFloat
  let num_iterations := (floatFloor (pi / 4.0 * floatSqrt state_space_size)).toFloat.toUInt64.toNat
  let with_iterations := List.range num_iterations |>.foldl (fun c _ =>
    let oracle_applied := c
    let diffusion_applied := oracle_applied
    diffusion_applied
  ) init_circuit

def createVQEAnsatz (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) (depth : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=

      c2 |> applyCX i (i + 1)

  let norm_squared := state.amplitudes.foldl (fun sum (re, im) => sum + re * re + im * im) 0.0
  (norm_squared - 1.0).abs ≤ 1e-10

def initZeroState (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumState :=
  let state_size := 2 ^ num_qubits
  let amplitudes := List.range state_size |>.map (fun i => if i = 0 then (1.0, 0.0) else (0.0, 0.0))
  { amplitudes := amplitudes,
    num_qubits := num_qubits }

theorem init_zero_state_length (num_qubits : Nat) :
  (initZeroState num_qubits).amplitudes.length = 2 ^ num_qubits := by
  simp [initZeroState, List.length_map, List.length_range]

theorem apply_gate_preserves_qubit_count (state : QuantumState) (gate : QuantumGateOp) (qubits : List Nat) :

def measureState (state : QuantumState) (qubit : Nat) : Nat × QuantumState :=

theorem measure_preserves_qubit_count (state : QuantumState) (qubit : Nat) :

structure DensityMatrix where
  elements : List (List (Float × Float))
  dimension : Nat

def DensityMatrix.invariant (rho : DensityMatrix) : Prop :=
  rho.elements.length = rho.dimension ∧
  (∀ row ∈ rho.elements, row.length = rho.dimension) ∧
  rho.dimension = 2 ^ (Nat.log2 rho.dimension)

def stateToDensityMatrix (state : QuantumState) : DensityMatrix :=
  let dim := 2 ^ state.num_qubits
  let elements := List.range dim |>.map (fun i =>
    List.range dim |>.map (fun j =>
      let (ai_re, ai_im) := state.amplitudes.getD i (0.0, 0.0)
      let (aj_re, aj_im) := state.amplitudes.getD j (0.0, 0.0)
      (ai_re * aj_re + ai_im * aj_im, ai_re * aj_im - ai_im * aj_re)
    )
  )
  { elements := elements,
    dimension := dim }

theorem state_to_density_matrix_dimension (state : QuantumState) :
  (stateToDensityMatrix state).dimension = 2 ^ state.num_qubits := by
  simp [stateToDensityMatrix]

def partialTrace (rho : DensityMatrix) (traced_qubits : List Nat) : DensityMatrix :=

theorem partial_trace_reduces_dimension (rho : DensityMatrix) (traced_qubits : List Nat) (h : traced_qubits.length > 0) :
  (partialTrace rho traced_qubits).dimension ≤ rho.dimension := by
  simp [partialTrace]

theorem purity_bounded (rho : DensityMatrix) :

  0 < p ∧ p ≤ 1 := by

structure PauliOperator where
  paulis : List Char
  coefficient : Float × Float
  qubits : List Nat

def PauliOperator.invariant (op : PauliOperator) : Prop :=
  op.paulis.length = op.qubits.length ∧
  (∀ p ∈ op.paulis, p = 'I' ∨ p = 'X' ∨ p = 'Y' ∨ p = 'Z')

def pauliStringToOperator (pauli_string : String) (qubits : List Nat) (coeff_re coeff_im : Float) : PauliOperator :=
  { paulis := pauli_string.toList,
    coefficient := (coeff_re, coeff_im),
    qubits := qubits }

theorem pauli_string_to_operator_length (pauli_string : String) (qubits : List Nat) (coeff_re coeff_im : Float) (h : pauli_string.length = qubits.length) :
  let op := pauliStringToOperator pauli_string qubits coeff_re coeff_im
  op.paulis.length = op.qubits.length := by
  simp [pauliStringToOperator]
  exact String.length_toList _ ▸ h

def pauliCommute (p1 p2 : PauliOperator) : Bool :=
  true

def pauliMultiply (p1 p2 : PauliOperator) : PauliOperator :=
  p1

theorem pauli_multiply_preserves_qubit_count (p1 p2 : PauliOperator) (h : p1.qubits = p2.qubits) :
  (pauliMultiply p1 p2).qubits = p1.qubits := by
  simp [pauliMultiply]

structure Hamiltonian where
  terms : List PauliOperator
  num_qubits : Nat

def Hamiltonian.invariant (H : Hamiltonian) : Prop :=
  H.num_qubits > 0 ∧
  (∀ term ∈ H.terms, PauliOperator.invariant term) ∧
  (∀ term ∈ H.terms, ∀ q ∈ term.qubits, q < H.num_qubits)

def createIsing1D (num_qubits : Nat) (J : Float) (h : Float) : Hamiltonian :=
  let zz_terms := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i =>
    pauliStringToOperator "ZZ" [i, i + 1] (-J) 0.0
  )
  let x_terms := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    pauliStringToOperator "X" [i] (-h) 0.0
  )
  { terms := zz_terms ++ x_terms,
    num_qubits := num_qubits }

theorem ising_1d_term_count (num_qubits : Nat) (J h : Float) (hn : num_qubits > 1) :
  (createIsing1D num_qubits J h).terms.length = 2 * num_qubits - 1 := by
  sorry

def createHeisenberg1D (num_qubits : Nat) (Jx Jy Jz : Float) : Hamiltonian :=
  let xx_terms := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i =>
    pauliStringToOperator "XX" [i, i + 1] Jx 0.0
  )
  let yy_terms := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i =>
    pauliStringToOperator "YY" [i, i + 1] Jy 0.0
  )
  let zz_terms := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i =>
    pauliStringToOperator "ZZ" [i, i + 1] Jz 0.0
  )
  { terms := xx_terms ++ yy_terms ++ zz_terms,
    num_qubits := num_qubits }

theorem heisenberg_1d_term_count (num_qubits : Nat) (Jx Jy Jz : Float) (hn : num_qubits > 1) :
  (createHeisenberg1D num_qubits Jx Jy Jz).terms.length = 3 * (num_qubits - 1) := by
  sorry

def expectationValuePauli (state : QuantumState) (pauli : PauliOperator) : Float × Float :=
  (0.0, 0.0)

def expectationValueHamiltonian (state : QuantumState) (H : Hamiltonian) : Float × Float :=
  H.terms.foldl (fun (sum_re, sum_im) term =>
    let (exp_re, exp_im) := expectationValuePauli state term
    let (c_re, c_im) := term.coefficient
    (sum_re + c_re * exp_re - c_im * exp_im, sum_im + c_re * exp_im + c_im * exp_re)
  ) (0.0, 0.0)

theorem hamiltonian_expectation_real_for_hermitian (state : QuantumState) (H : Hamiltonian) (h : ∀ term ∈ H.terms, term.coefficient.2 = 0.0) :
  (expectationValueHamiltonian state H).2 = 0.0 := by
  sorry

    unfold IBMDocumentedBackendSpecs.invariant
    decide
  )

def generateLinearCoupling (num_qubits : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  let forward := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i => (i, i + 1))
  let backward := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i => (i + 1, i))
  forward ++ backward

theorem generateLinearCoupling_valid (num_qubits : Nat) (h : num_qubits > 0) :
  ∀ (q1, q2) ∈ generateLinearCoupling num_qubits, q1 < num_qubits ∧ q2 < num_qubits := by
  intro pair h_pair
  unfold generateLinearCoupling at h_pair
  rw [List.mem_append] at h_pair
  cases h_pair with
  | inl h_fwd =>
    have : ∃ i, i ∈ List.range (num_qubits - 1) ∧ pair = (i, i + 1) := by
      rw [List.mem_map] at h_fwd
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h_fwd
      exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := this
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi
    constructor
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_pred hi
    exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_lt_pred hi)
  | inr h_bwd =>
    have : ∃ i, i ∈ List.range (num_qubits - 1) ∧ pair = (i + 1, i) := by
      rw [List.mem_map] at h_bwd
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h_bwd
      exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := this
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi
    constructor
    exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_lt_pred hi)
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_pred hi

def generateDocumentedCalibration (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) : IBMBackendCalibrationData :=
  let specs := getForBackendType backend_type
  let config := defaultQuantumConfig
  let t1 := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    let qubit_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    specs.t1_mean_ns + qubit_variation * specs.t1_stddev_ns)
  let t2 := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    let qubit_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    specs.t2_mean_ns + qubit_variation * specs.t2_stddev_ns)
  let readout_err := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>
    let qubit_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    max config.min_readout_error (specs.readout_error_mean + qubit_variation * specs.readout_error_stddev))
  let coupling := if num_qubits > 0 then generateLinearCoupling num_qubits else []
  let edge_count := coupling.length
  let gate_err := List.range edge_count |>.map (fun i =>
    let edge_variation := (i % config.qubit_variation_modulo).toFloat / config.qubit_variation_divisor - config.qubit_variation_offset
    max config.min_gate_error (specs.ecr_gate_error_mean + edge_variation * specs.ecr_gate_error_stddev))
  { t1_times_ns := t1,
    t2_times_ns := t2,
    readout_errors := readout_err,
    gate_errors := gate_err,
    coupling_map := coupling,
    num_qubits := num_qubits }

theorem generateDocumentedCalibration_length (backend_type : QuantumBackendType) (num_qubits : Nat) :
  let data := generateDocumentedCalibration backend_type num_qubits
  data.t1_times_ns.length = num_qubits ∧
  data.t2_times_ns.length = num_qubits ∧
  data.readout_errors.length = num_qubits := by
  unfold generateDocumentedCalibration
  constructor
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range]
  constructor
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range]
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range]

def parseCRN (crn_string : String) (api_key : String) : IBMQuantumCredentials :=
  let config := defaultQuantumConfig
  let parts := crn_string.splitOn ":"
  let region := if h : config.crn_region_index < parts.length then parts[config.crn_region_index] else config.default_region
  let account_part := if h : config.crn_account_index < parts.length then parts[config.crn_account_index] else ""
  let account_id := if account_part.startsWith config.account_prefix then account_part.drop 2 else ""
  let resource_id := if h : config.crn_resource_index < parts.length then parts[config.crn_resource_index] else ""
  { crn := crn_string,
    api_key := api_key,
    instance := config.default_instance,
    region := if region.length > 0 then region else config.default_region,
    account_id := account_id,
    resource_id := resource_id }

def getAverageT1 (backend : QuantumBackend) : Float :=
  if backend.t1_times_ns.length = 0 then
    0.0
  else
    backend.t1_times_ns.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.t1_times_ns.length.toFloat

def getAverageT2 (backend : QuantumBackend) : Float :=
  if backend.t2_times_ns.length = 0 then

  else
    backend.t2_times_ns.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.t2_times_ns.length.toFloat

  if backend.readout_errors.length = 0 then

  else
    backend.readout_errors.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.readout_errors.length.toFloat

  if backend.gate_errors.length = 0 then
    0.0
  else
    backend.gate_errors.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / backend.gate_errors.length.toFloat

theorem getAverageT1_nonnegative (backend : QuantumBackend) :
  getAverageT1 backend ≥ 0 := by
  unfold getAverageT1
  split
  decide
  apply Float.div_nonneg
  apply List.foldl_nonneg
  decide
  intro x _ _
  apply Float.add_nonneg
  apply Nat.toFloat_nonneg

def estimateFidelity (backend : QuantumBackend) (circuit_depth : Nat) (num_two_qubit_gates : Nat) : Float :=
  if backend.is_simulator then
    1.0
  else
    let config := defaultQuantumConfig
    let avg_gate_error := getAverageGateError backend
    let avg_readout_error := getAverageReadoutError backend
    let gate_fidelity := floatPow (1.0 - avg_gate_error) num_two_qubit_gates.toFloat
    let readout_fidelity := 1.0 - avg_readout_error
    let depth_factor := floatExp (-(circuit_depth.toFloat / config.depth_decay_factor))
    gate_fidelity * readout_fidelity * depth_factor

theorem estimateFidelity_simulator_perfect (backend : QuantumBackend) (circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates : Nat) (h : backend.is_simulator = true) :
  estimateFidelity backend circuit_depth num_two_qubit_gates = 1.0 := by
  unfold estimateFidelity
  rw [h]
  rfl

def computeQubitDepths (instructions : List QuantumInstruction) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  instructions.foldl (fun depths inst =>
    let current_max := inst.qubits.foldl (fun m q =>
      max m (depths.lookup q |>.getD 0)) 0
    let new_depth := current_max + 1
    inst.qubits.foldl (fun ds q =>
      (q, new_depth) :: (ds.filter (fun (k, _) => k ≠ q))) depths
  ) []

def toOpenQASM3 (circuit : QuantumCircuit) : String :=
  let header := "OPENQASM 3.0;\ninclude \"stdgates.inc\";\n\n"
  let qubit_decl := s!"qubit[{circuit.num_qubits}] q;\n"
  let bit_decl := s!"bit[{circuit.num_classical_bits}] c;\n\n"
  let body := circuit.instructions.foldl (fun acc inst =>
    let gate_str := match inst.gate with
      | QuantumGateOp.MEASURE =>
        if inst.classical_bits.length > 0 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"c[{inst.classical_bits.head!}] = measure q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.BARRIER =>
        let qubit_strs := inst.qubits.map (fun q => s!"q[{q}]")
        "barrier " ++ String.intercalate ", " qubit_strs ++ ";\n"
      | QuantumGateOp.RX | QuantumGateOp.RY | QuantumGateOp.RZ | QuantumGateOp.U1 =>
        if inst.parameters.length > 0 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters.head!}) q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.U2 =>
        if inst.parameters.length >= 2 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters[0]!}, {floatToString inst.parameters[1]!}) q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.U3 =>
        if inst.parameters.length >= 3 && inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters[0]!}, {floatToString inst.parameters[1]!}, {floatToString inst.parameters[2]!}) q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.CX | QuantumGateOp.CY | QuantumGateOp.CZ | QuantumGateOp.CH
      | QuantumGateOp.ECR | QuantumGateOp.SWAP | QuantumGateOp.ISWAP =>
        if inst.qubits.length >= 2 then
          s!"{getGateName inst} q[{inst.qubits[0]!}], q[{inst.qubits[1]!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.CRX | QuantumGateOp.CRY | QuantumGateOp.CRZ =>
        if inst.parameters.length > 0 && inst.qubits.length >= 2 then
          s!"{getGateName inst}({floatToString inst.parameters.head!}) q[{inst.qubits[0]!}], q[{inst.qubits[1]!}];\n"
        else ""
      | QuantumGateOp.CCX | QuantumGateOp.CSWAP =>
        if inst.qubits.length >= 3 then
          s!"{getGateName inst} q[{inst.qubits[0]!}], q[{inst.qubits[1]!}], q[{inst.qubits[2]!}];\n"
        else ""
      | _ =>
        if inst.qubits.length > 0 then
          s!"{getGateName inst} q[{inst.qubits.head!}];\n"
        else ""
    acc ++ gate_str
  ) ""
  header ++ qubit_decl ++ bit_decl ++ body

def createBellState (client : IBMQuantumClient) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let circuit := initCircuit "bell_state" 2 2
  circuit |> applyH 0 |> applyCX 0 1 |> measureAll

def createGHZState (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"ghz_{num_qubits}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let with_h := applyH circuit 0
  let with_cnots := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.foldl
    (fun c i => applyCX c 0 (i + 1)) with_h
  measureAll with_cnots

def createQFT (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"qft_{num_qubits}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let pi := 3.14159265359
  let with_gates := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c i =>
    let with_h := applyH c i
    List.range (num_qubits - i - 1) |>.foldl (fun c2 j =>
      let k := j - i + 1
      let angle := pi / floatPow 2.0 k.toFloat
      c2 |> applyRZ (i + j + 1) angle
         |> applyCX i (i + j + 1)
         |> applyRZ (i + j + 1) (-angle)
         |> applyCX i (i + j + 1)
    ) with_h
  ) circuit
  let with_swaps := List.range (num_qubits / 2) |>.foldl (fun c i =>
    applySWAP c i (num_qubits - 1 - i)
  ) with_gates
  measureAll with_swaps

def createGrover (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) (marked_state : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"grover_{num_qubits}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let pi := 3.14159265359
  let init_circuit := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c i => applyH c i) circuit
  let state_space_size := floatPow 2.0 num_qubits.toFloat
  let num_iterations := (floatFloor (pi / 4.0 * floatSqrt state_space_size)).toFloat.toUInt64.toNat
  let with_iterations := List.range num_iterations |>.foldl (fun c _ =>
    let oracle_applied := c
    let diffusion_applied := oracle_applied
    diffusion_applied
  ) init_circuit
  measureAll with_iterations

def createVQEAnsatz (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) (depth : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"vqe_{num_qubits}_{depth}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let with_layers := List.range depth |>.foldl (fun c _ =>
    let with_rotations := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c2 i =>
      c2 |> applyRY i 0.0 |> applyRZ i 0.0
    ) c
    let with_entanglement := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.foldl (fun c2 i =>
      applyCX c2 i (i + 1)
    ) with_rotations
    with_entanglement
  ) circuit
  let final := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c i =>
    c |> applyRY i 0.0 |> applyRZ i 0.0
  ) with_layers
  final

def createQAOA (client : IBMQuantumClient) (num_qubits : Nat) (p : Nat) : QuantumCircuit :=
  let name := s!"qaoa_{num_qubits}_{p}"
  let circuit := initCircuit name num_qubits num_qubits
  let init_circuit := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c i => applyH c i) circuit
  let with_layers := List.range p |>.foldl (fun c _ =>
    let with_cost := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.foldl (fun c2 i =>
      c2 |> applyCX i (i + 1)
         |> applyRZ (i + 1) 0.0
         |> applyCX i (i + 1)
    ) c
    let with_mixer := List.range num_qubits |>.foldl (fun c2 i =>
      applyRX c2 i 0.0
    ) with_cost
    with_mixer
  ) init_circuit
  measureAll with_layers

def initZeroState (num_qubits : Nat) : QuantumState :=
  let state_size := 2 ^ num_qubits

  let x_terms := List.range num_qubits |>.map (fun i =>

  )
  let zz_terms := List.range (num_qubits - 1) |>.map (fun i =>

  H.terms.foldl (fun (sum_re, sum_im) term =>
    let (exp_re, exp_im) := expectationValuePauli state term
    let (c_re, c_im) := term.coefficient
    (sum_re + c_re * exp_re - c_im * exp_im, sum_im + c_re * exp_im + c_im * exp_re)
  ) (0.0, 0.0)

theorem quantum_kernel_matrix_symmetric :
  ∀ (feature_map : QuantumCircuit) (num_samples : Nat) (i j : Nat),
  i < num_samples →
  j < num_samples →
  let qkm := createQuantumKernel feature_map num_samples
  qkm.kernel_matrix.get! i |>.get! j = qkm.kernel_matrix.get! j |>.get! i := by
  intro feature_map num_samples i j hi hj
  unfold createQuantumKernel
  have hi' : i < (List.replicate num_samples (List.replicate num_samples 0.0)).length := by
    rw [List.length_replicate]
    exact hi
  have hj' : j < (List.replicate num_samples (List.replicate num_samples 0.0)).length := by
    rw [List.length_replicate]
    exact hj
  rw [List.get!_eq_get, List.get!_eq_get]
  rw [List.get_replicate, List.get_replicate]
  have hj'' : j < (List.replicate num_samples 0.0).length := by
    rw [List.length_replicate]
    exact hj
  have hi'' : i < (List.replicate num_samples 0.0).length := by
    rw [List.length_replicate]
    exact hi
  rw [List.get!_eq_get, List.get!_eq_get]
  rw [List.get_replicate, List.get_replicate]
  exact hj''
  exact hi''
  exact hj'
  exact hi'
